verdicts.evidence: Skill L8: "A set of completed phases has been submitted for cross-phase integration audit. Verify that phases actually wire together — not that each phase individually looks complete." KICKOFF L901: "*(skip on the milestone's first phase — nothing is cross-phase yet)*"
verdicts.reasoning: Verified both quotes exist verbatim at the cited lines. Grepped the full agent file for 'first phase|skip|only one phase|single phase|no-op' and found only an unrelated hit at L375 ('exist in a single phase' — a Requirements Integration Map template line, not a gating condition). verdicts.evidence: Skill L16: "**Artifact paths are configurable.** Defaults below use `docs/milestones/<M>/phases/<NN>-<slug>/` for phase summaries — use whatever paths the dispatch prompt provides." KICKOFF L909-912: "the completed phase directories in this milestone by path (every phase up to and including <NN>, not just this one), the key exports each one declares in its PHASE/<NN>-<MM>-SUMMARY.md, and the requirement bank — SPEC/spec.md's US-xxx story IDs with their descriptions and the phase each is assigned to."

The skill's own default path (`docs/milestones/<M>/phases/<NN>-<slug>/...SUMMARY.md`) differs from this project's actual convention (`PHASE/<NN>-<MM>-SUMMARY.md`, `SPEC/spec.md`), and the skill explicitly says to use whatever the dispatch prompt provides — meaning this text IS the substitution the skill is waiting for. The cumulative-scope instruction ('every phase up to and including <NN>, not just this one') also sharpens the skill's vaguer <inputs> bullet ('Phase directories in milestone scope', L56) with a concrete boundary the skill cannot infer on its own. KEEP — these are invocation arguments, not restated methodology.
